overview_description.description: BizConnect is an AI-powered business card scanner and contact management platform that helps professionals digitize, organize, and manage networking contacts efficiently. The app supports OCR-based card scanning in 30+ languages, CRM integrations, lead tracking, task management, and team collaboration. BizConnect integrates with Google Contacts, Outlook, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, and Zapier, enabling seamless workflow automation for businesses, sales teams, and entrepreneurs worldwide.

about_short_description.short_description: BizConnect is a card scanning and network managing app that scans, digitizes, manages and visualize business contacts and lead performances.

product.name: Business Card Scanner
product.description: An app feature that scans and digitizes business cards and documents with high accuracy, supporting over 30 languages.

product.name: Contact Management
product.description: A system to organize, group, and manage digitized contacts and business leads within the app.

product.name: Team and Task Management
product.description: Tools to create teams, assign tasks, track activities, and monitor lead and revenue performance for team members.

product.name: Lead and Sales Performance Reporting
product.description: A reporting tool that visualizes team members' lead conversion rates and sales performance metrics.

product.name: Export and Import Integration
product.description: Functionality to export and import contacts and leads between BizConnect and external platforms like Google Contacts, Outlook, Excel, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho.
